thread:
Claire Park: opened PR to add an "ipset + conntrack" troubleshooting appendix to the private installer HSM chapter. adds ipset bulk rules, cert rotation checklist, and a short C# SDK snippet for sidecar testing. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4891

Omar Khan: nice. customers with large fleets hit conntrack exhaustion during mass cert rotates. can you include a recommended rollout pattern and sample sysctl values?

Claire Park: adding a staggered rollout pattern: update 10% groups, wait 5m, check conntrack and TLS errors, proceed. sysctl examples: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=432000`.

Jen Rivera: include ipset snippet for quickly allowing many HSM gateway IPs without long iptables rulesets. ops love this.

Claire Park: ipset example added:```bash
# create set and add gateways
ipset create redwood_hsm hash:ip family inet
ipset add redwood_hsm 10.20.0.5
ipset add redwood_hsm 10.20.0.6
# use in iptables
iptables -I OUTPUT -p tcp -m set --match-set redwood_hsm dst --dport 4731 -j ACCEPT
```

Omar Khan: also add nftables equivalent and a one-liner to dump conntrack states for a specific IP so SREs can triage.

Claire Park: nftables rule and conntrack dump added: `conntrack -L | grep 10.20.0.5` and `nft add rule inet filter output ip daddr @redwood_hsm tcp dport 4731 accept`.

Jen Rivera: cert rotation checklist please: minimal safe steps for private installs (pre-stage certs on sidecar, test with local tunnel, rotate, stagger). short bullet list will do.

Claire Park: checklist in PR:
1) stage new certs on sidecar hosts (do not reload yet)
2) test new certs via ssh tunnel: `ssh -L127.0.0.1:4731:10.20.0.5:4731 bastion -N` and curl the sidecar endpoint
3) roll new cert to 10% of sidecars, monitor TLS handshakes and conntrack
4) if healthy, proceed in waves; if not, rollback to previous cert and investigate

Omar Khan: please add a WARN about disabling TLS verification — only for isolated testing. customers sometimes disable tls verify and then forget.

Claire Park: WARN box added: do not disable TLS verification in production; include example `curl --insecure` only for testing behind a tunnel.

Jen Rivera: SDK snippet — we have Python/Go/Node. let's add a minimal C# example that points at the local sidecar so customers writing .NET apps can test quickly.

Claire Park: C# snippet added under "SDK snippets":```csharp
using Redwood;
class Program {
  static void Main() {
    var client = new Client(new ClientOptions { ApiKey = "REDACTED", BaseUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:8080" });
    var res = client.Generate("hi");
    System.Console.WriteLine(res.Text);
  }
}
```

Omar Khan: minor: document REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT override for sidecar tests and mention HSM port 4731.

Claire Park: done. added `export REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:4731` note and a short troubleshooting step: if TLS handshake stalls, check conntrack entries and NAT idle timeouts on the gateway.

docs-lint-bot: ERROR: PR 4891 - broken internal link to /private/install/hsm-rotation. Suggested /private/vpc/hsm-rotation.

Claire Park: thanks bot. updated cross-links and added a redirect note for the old path. grepping for other occurrences now.

infra-sre-bot: INFO: Can confirm conntrack_max=262144 was used successfully in customer X during a 3k-node rollout. Suggest monitoring nf_conntrack_count and tune alarm at 80%.

Jen Rivera: add a tiny LogQL example for TLS handshake failures so on-call can alert: `|~ "tls handshake" | count_over_time(5m)`.

Claire Park: added Loki query and recommended alert threshold. final checklist before merge: ipset + nft examples, sysctls, conntrack diag tips, cert rotation checklist, C# SDK snippet, REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT note, and link fixes. tagging security and infra for quick review.

Omar Khan: LGTM from infra side pending docs CI. please include the WARN about public exposure of 4731.

Claire Park: WARN included. merging after CI green. will open a follow-up thread if we see post-release tickets. :shipit:
